Chapter 411 - 411 I Have To Go To Class Soon; Worry!

Chapter 411 - 411 I Have to Go to Class Soon; Worry!

411 I Have to Go to Class Soon; Worry!

Feng Zhixiang laughed for a while.

“Where’s the super battery?” he asked. “Can you take me there?”

Lin Fan looked at the students coming and going and said, “But I have to go to class soon.”

“What’s the use of attending classes?” Feng Zhixiang asked.

Zhao Xueqin could not help but say, “You don’t have to go to class.”

“Yeah,” Li Rongfa also said.

Lin Fan’s lips twitched.

‘You guys are the director of the Institute of Science and professors, but you’re telling a student that going to classes is useless and that there is no need to go to class?

‘Are you sure there’s nothing wrong with your words?’

Lin Fan looked at their serious and impatient expressions and said, “Alright, then I’ll bring you guys over to take a look.”

In his heart, he thought, ‘Looks like I have to skip class again today.’

Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa quickly said, “Can we go over and take a look too?”

They were chemistry professors and mainly studied chemical batteries.

Naturally, they were looking forward to the super battery.

In their hearts, taking a look at it would be a historic moment!

They did not want to miss it!

Feng Zhixiang could not help but frown.

He did not know Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa.

In addition, this super battery could be said to be related to the future of Hua Nation’s new energy vehicles! He definitely could not let anyone get close!

Once the secret was leaked, it would definitely be a matter of regret.

Lin Fan also understood what Feng Zhixiang was thinking. He introduced, “This is Professor Zhao Xueqin and Professor Li Rongfa. They’re the second authors of the thesis ‘The Principle and Use of Super Batteries.’ They also helped me a lot when I invented the super battery.”

Lin Fan had no intention of lying about this.

One had to know…

If they had not let him watch their experiment…

Then, there was no way Lin Fan could complete the mission.

However, when Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa heard this, they had a different feeling.

They were so embarrassed that their old faces turned red.

Lin Fan was speaking up for them all the time.

In fact, he even wanted to share some of the credit with them.

“Actually, we didn’t help Lin Fan at all,” Zhao Xueqin said.

“Yes,” Li Rongfa said.

They had their names as the second authors.

They were already very satisfied.

As for giving them a portion of the credit?

That would be a little shameful.

Feng Zhixiang heard Lin Fan’s words and nodded. “Since that’s the case, let’s go together.”

Then, Lin Fan opened the door of the Cullinan and got in.

Feng Zhixiang, Zhao Xueqin, and Li Rongfa also followed suit.

Although one of them was a director and the other two were professors, they had never sat in a Cullinan.

Most people would be very curious when it was their first time sitting in a luxury car like a Cullinan.

However, they were not curious at all.

There was only anticipation in their hearts, endless anticipation for the super battery!

About 20 minutes later, the Cullinan arrived at the Coiling Dragon Villa.

Lin Fan pointed at the black cube that was placed on the ground and said, “That’s it.”

“This is the super battery?” Feng Zhixiang said in surprise. “It’s only the size of a desktop computer…”

As he spoke, he even bent down to lift it.

“It weighs… about 20 kilograms.”

Then, Feng Zhixiang continued, “Lin Fan, if this super battery is used in a new energy vehicle, how many kilometers can it last?”

“If we don’t consider the electrical consumption…” Lin Fan said. “The car can last for 3,000 kilometers.”

“3,000 kilometers!” Feng Zhixiang, Zhao Xueqin, and Li Rongfa shouted in shock.

A battery the size of a computer weighed only about 20 kilograms and could allow a vehicle to last for 3,000 kilometers!

What a terrifying number!!

The hearts of the three of them thumped like drums.

After a long time, Feng Zhixiang came back to his senses and asked, “Lin Fan, can I bring this super battery back for research?”

“Sure,” Lin Fan said. “Oh right, I’m preparing to start commercial production of batteries. I should be working with Yadi Automobile.”

“Lin Fan, I thank you on behalf of Hua Nation!” Feng Zhixiang said solemnly.”

Lin Fan had really helped Hua Nation a lot.

Lin Fan waved his hand and said, “It’s just a small thing. You don’t have to mind it.”

A small matter?

He invented a super battery that would completely overturn the traditional car industry and allow Hua Nation’s cars to overtake other cars.

Just a small matter?

Feng Zhixiang, Zhao Xueqin, and Li Rongfa opened their mouths, not knowing what to say.

However, to Lin Fan, this was indeed a small toy.

It was because he had the system!

Feng Zhixiang made a call.

About half an hour later, a helicopter slowly landed.

A few soldiers walked over with their heads held high.

The soldier at the front shouted, “Hello, Department Director Feng!”

Feng Zhixiang nodded, then picked up the super battery and said, “This is it. Sorry to trouble you.”

“This is what we should do!” the soldier said.

The helicopter was here, and Feng Zhixiang now needed to go to Jingbei.

He first asked Lin Fan if he wanted to go to Jingbei but was rejected.

However, Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa wanted to follow him.

One had to know…

This was a great opportunity to go to the Institute of Science and study super batteries with many academicians and big names.

Feng Zhixiang explained some confidential information, and Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa gladly accepted the terms.

After the helicopter roared, the group left the Coiling Dragon Villa.

Lin Fan was the only one lying on the soft sofa, his face filled with satisfaction.

He took out his phone and casually scrolled through the news. He realized that the news was all about super batteries.

For a moment, he could not help but feel a little bored.

Hence, Lin Fan dialed the number of Wang Fugui, the chairman of Yadi Automobile.

…

Yadi Automobile.

Yesterday, Wang Fugui learned from the technical director that a new type of energy battery had appeared in the latest edition of Nature. Its power far exceeded all the current new energy batteries.

According to the calculations, if the research and development were successful, the electric vehicle’s range could reach more than 2,500 kilometers!

What a terrifying number!

Compared to all the existing new energy batteries, it was not an exaggeration to say that the super battery had given them a big blow!

When Wang Fugui heard the news, he was not happy.

On the contrary, he was very worried.

This was because a large part of Yadi Automobile’s focus was on developing new energy batteries.

After years of research, Yadi Automobile finally made great achievements and invented the world-leading blade battery.

It was because of this that the sales of Yadi cars could rise steadily.

In order to develop, many new energy vehicle companies chose to spend a lot of money to buy blade batteries.

It was not easy for them to develop in this direction.

With the appearance of the super battery, perhaps everything would soon turn into nothing!

How could Chairman Wang Fugui not be worried?

At this moment, Wang Fugui’s mobile phone rang.
